tag.name: Communications
tag.description: Send email/SMS and manage inbound message association.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:communications`

Send an email to a customer on behalf of the tenant via the configured email provider (Resend). The recipient is resolved from the customer's contacts: if `contact_id` is supplied that contact is used, otherwise the customer's primary contact is used; the resolved contact must have an email address (409 if it does not). Sends are deduplicated by `idempotency_key` (scoped to outbound email): a repeat call with a previously-seen key returns the existing communication with HTTP 200 instead of creating a new one. `subject_type` and `subject_id` must be supplied together or omitted together.

201.description: The email was accepted and a new outbound communication row was created (status `queued`/`sending`).

200.description: Duplicate request — a communication with the same `idempotency_key` already existed; the existing communication is returned unchanged.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:communications`

Send an SMS to a customer on behalf of the tenant via the configured SMS provider (Twilio). The recipient is resolved from the customer's contacts: if `contact_id` is supplied that contact is used, otherwise the customer's primary contact is used. The resolved contact must have a phone number (409 if it does not) and must be SMS-enabled — a contact opted out of SMS (`phone_can_sms` false) yields 409. Sends are deduplicated by `idempotency_key` (scoped to outbound SMS): a repeat call with a previously-seen key returns the existing communication with HTTP 200 instead of creating a new one. `subject_type` and `subject_id` must be supplied together or omitted together.

201.description: The SMS was accepted and a new outbound communication row was created (status `queued`/`sending`).

200.description: Duplicate request — a communication with the same `idempotency_key` already existed; the existing communication is returned unchanged.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:communications`

List inbound communications that have not yet been linked to a customer (`direction` is `inbound` and `customer_id` is null), most recent first. Use these to triage messages that could not be auto-correlated to a customer, then attach them with the associate-customer endpoint. Pagination is keyed on `created_at`: pass the previous page's `next_cursor` as `cursor` to fetch older rows.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only include communications created at or after this ISO-8601 datetime (inclusive lower bound).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor — the `created_at` value (ISO-8601 datetime) of the last row from the previous page; returns rows created strictly before it. Taken from the previous response's `next_cursor`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of communications to return (default 50, min 1, max 100).

200.description: A page of unassociated inbound communications.

next_cursor.description: The `created_at` of the last row in this page, to be passed as `cursor` for the next page; null when there are no more results.

patch.summary: Associate a communication with a customer
patch.description:
**Required scope:** `write:communications`

Link a communication (typically an unassociated inbound message) to a customer, optionally also setting a contact. The target customer must exist in this tenant and not be soft-deleted (404 otherwise). The communication must exist in this tenant (404 otherwise). Passing no `contact_id` clears any existing contact association.

200.description: The updated communication, now linked to the customer.

CommunicationSubjectType.description: The kind of business entity a communication relates to.

CommunicationChannel.description: The channel the communication was sent or received on.

CommunicationDirection.description: Direction of the communication relative to the tenant.

CommunicationProvider.description: The provider that handled the communication.

CommunicationDmarcStatus.description: Gateway-reported DMARC verdict for inbound email; null for non-email rows or older payloads without a verdict.

CommunicationAttachment.description: A file attachment on a communication.

storage_path.description: Path of the stored file in object storage.

Communication.description: A communication record (a single email, SMS, call, or other message) belonging to the tenant.

customer_id.description: Linked customer id, or null when not yet associated (e.g. an untriaged inbound message).

contact_id.description: Linked customer contact id, or null.

subject.description: Message subject line (email); null for channels without a subject.

provider.description: The provider that handled the communication, or null.

provider_message_id.description: Provider-assigned message id (e.g. Twilio SID, Resend id), once sent.

from_address.description: Sender address (phone number or email), or null.

to_address.description: Recipient address (phone number or email), or null.

subject_type.description: The kind of business entity this communication relates to, or null.

subject_id.description: Id of the related business entity, or null.

sent_at.description: When the message was handed to the provider, or null.

delivered_at.description: When the message was confirmed delivered, or null.

read_at.description: When the message was read, or null.

failure_reason.description: Provider/handler failure detail when status is `failed`, or null.

ai_session_id.description: Linked AI session id, if the communication was AI-handled.

ai_handled.description: Whether the communication was handled by the AI assistant.

escalated_to_human_at.description: When the communication was escalated to a human, or null.

escalated_reason.description: Reason for human escalation, or null.

dmarc_status.description: Gateway DMARC verdict for inbound email rows, or null.

created_by.description: Id of the user that created the row, or null.

updated_by.description: Id of the user that last updated the row, or null.

CommunicationEmailSend.description: Payload to send an email. `subject_type` and `subject_id` must both be present or both absent.

customer_id.description: Id of the customer to email.

contact_id.description: Specific contact to email. If omitted, the customer's primary contact is used.

subject_type.description: The kind of business entity this email relates to. Must be sent together with `subject_id`.

subject_id.description: Id of the related business entity. Must be sent together with `subject_type`.

attachments.description: Optional file attachments referencing already-uploaded storage objects.

storage_path.description: Path of the stored file in object storage.

file_name.description: Display file name for the attachment.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-supplied key used to deduplicate sends. Reusing a key returns the existing communication with HTTP 200.

CommunicationSmsSend.description: Payload to send an SMS. `subject_type` and `subject_id` must both be present or both absent.

customer_id.description: Id of the customer to text.

contact_id.description: Specific contact to text. If omitted, the customer's primary contact is used.

subject_type.description: The kind of business entity this SMS relates to. Must be sent together with `subject_id`.

subject_id.description: Id of the related business entity. Must be sent together with `subject_type`.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-supplied key used to deduplicate sends. Reusing a key returns the existing communication with HTTP 200.

CommunicationAssociateCustomer.description: Payload to link a communication to a customer (and optionally a contact).

customer_id.description: Id of the customer to associate the communication with.

contact_id.description: Optional contact to associate. When omitted, any existing contact association is cleared.
